## Access conventions

- **GET / SET:** use `live.get(name, **kwargs)` / `live.set(name, value, **kwargs)`. Simple settings also support attributes, e.g. `live.frequency` / `live.frequency = value`.
- **CALL:** use `live.call(name, *args, **kwargs)` or `live.operation(...)`. Displayed signatures omit the driver instance (`self`).
- Command blocks show normalized `FloatCommand`, `IntCommand`, `BoolCommand`, `StringCommand`, or `RampCommand` declarations, including SCPI templates and declared maps/ranges/choices. A value map lists Python values as keys and wire values as values; it can override the nominal command's readback type.
- `ManagedProperty` settings use handwritten getters/setters. Types, units, returns and constraints are only documented where supplied by the driver. Inspect implementation before assuming behavior not described here.
- A name beginning with `get_` does not guarantee read-only behavior: operations may trigger acquisition or change outputs. Lifecycle/direct-use-only methods and generated direct-driver helpers are not server CALL operations.

See [instrument usage and initialization caveats](../../components/instruments.md) for ownership and model-specific precautions. [Unavailable stubs](../../components/instruments.md#roles-and-drivers) are not admitted drivers and intentionally have no API pages.

Regenerate/check using the commands in [Maintaining the docs](../../maintaining.md#generated-instrument-reference).
